header.name: CMS8S78xx EPWM Hardware Fault Brake 0 Pin Mode headless proof

steps.description: P3.2 (pin 26) initially low or toggling with EPWM zero interrupt
P3.3 (pin 27) initialized low before external FB0 assertion
Assert FB0 input pin P0.6 (pin 6) to HIGH to trigger hardware fault brake
P3.3 (pin 27) toggles to 1 via Vector 18 IRQ on FB0 fault brake
